newsHighlights.title: Old department stores sell nostalgic journey to past
newsHighlights.summary: Old department stores across China are being renovated into cultural landmarks that offer visitors a nostalgic journey back to the past.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国各地的老百货商场被改造为文化地标，为游客提供一场重返过去的怀旧之旅。

newsHighlights.title: Why is the world learning Chinese?
newsHighlights.summary: A growing number of people around the world are learning Chinese to better understand China's culture, history and modern development.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球越来越多的人正在学习中文，以便更好地了解中国的文化、历史与当代发展。

newsHighlights.title: New China-DPRK border bridge opens to traffic
newsHighlights.summary: A newly built bridge on the China-DPRK border has opened to traffic, strengthening cross-border travel and trade ties.
newsHighlights.translation: 中朝边境一座新建大桥正式通车，进一步加强跨境旅行与贸易往来。

newsHighlights.title: Xi congratulates Hunan University on its centenary
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to Hunan University as the university celebrates the centenary of its official founding.
newsHighlights.translation: 在湖南大学迎来建校百年之际，习近平主席致信祝贺。

quote.quote: The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中一页。
quote.explanation: 这句话把世界比作一本书，强调旅行是认识多元文化、开阔视野的方式。今天的老百货怀旧热、跨境大桥通车与全球中文热，都说明走出去、去体验，才能真正读懂另一种文化。

vocabulary.definition: 怀旧的，令人怀念过去的
vocabulary.example: Old department stores offer customers a nostalgic journey to the past.
vocabulary.translation: 老百货商场为顾客提供一场怀旧的时光之旅。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自标题《Old department stores sell nostalgic journey to past》，形容老商场带来的怀旧体验。

vocabulary.definition: 怀旧之情，对往昔的眷恋
vocabulary.example: The renovated stores tap into a deep sense of nostalgia among young shoppers.
vocabulary.translation: 改造后的商场唤起了年轻顾客内心深处的怀旧情结。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自老百货商场新闻，指消费者对童年与旧时光的情感记忆。

vocabulary.example: Hunan University celebrated the centenary of its official founding this year.
vocabulary.translation: 湖南大学今年迎来了建校百年纪念。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自《Xi congratulates Hunan University on its centenary》，指学校建校一百周年。

vocabulary.example: The university held a series of events to commemorate its 100th anniversary.
vocabulary.translation: 该校举办了一系列活动以纪念建校一百周年。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联湖南大学百年校庆新闻中的纪念活动。

vocabulary.definition: 遗产；传统（尤指文化遗产）
vocabulary.example: These century-old buildings are part of the city's cultural heritage.
vocabulary.translation: 这些百年建筑是这座城市文化遗产的一部分。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自老百货商场与百年名校新闻，指代历史建筑与文化传统。

vocabulary.example: The old department store was renovated into a cultural and shopping landmark.
vocabulary.translation: 这家老百货商场被翻新改造为文化与购物地标。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自老百货商场改造新闻，指对旧建筑的整修升级。

vocabulary.example: The reopened store has quickly become a landmark for cultural travel in the city.
vocabulary.translation: 重新开业的商场迅速成为这座城市的文化旅行地标。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自老百货商场与中朝边境大桥新闻，均指具有标志意义的地点或事件。

vocabulary.example: A new bridge on the China-DPRK border has opened to traffic.
vocabulary.translation: 中朝边境的一座新桥已正式通车。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自《New China-DPRK border bridge opens to traffic》，指两国交界地带。

vocabulary.definition: 充满活力的，生机勃勃的
vocabulary.example: Learning Chinese has become a vibrant global trend among young people.
vocabulary.translation: 学习中文已成为年轻人中一股充满活力的全球潮流。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自《Why is the world learning Chinese?》，描述全球中文热的蓬勃态势。

vocabulary.example: The cultural tourism initiative aims to attract more visitors from home and abroad.
vocabulary.translation: 这项文化旅游倡议旨在吸引更多国内外游客。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联今日多条新闻中关于文化交流与跨境合作的倡议行动。

pattern.pattern: A is more than just B; it is C（A不仅仅是B，更是C）
pattern.example: Old department stores are more than just places to shop; they offer a nostalgic journey to the past.
pattern.translation: 老百货商场不仅仅是购物的地方，更是一场重返过去的怀旧之旅。
pattern.usage: 用于在写作或口语中深化主题、提升立意。结构为“主语 + is more than just + 名词; it is + 名词/名词短语”。注意 just 后接名词或动名词，分号后的分句用于补充更高层次的意义。

grammar.title: 不定式作后置定语（Infinitive as post-modifier）
grammar.explanation: 在英语新闻中，动词不定式常放在名词之后作定语，表示“用于……的”“将要……的”或“……的（目的/内容）”。被修饰的名词多为 need, plan, guidelines, decision, effort, bridge, way 等。结构为：名词 + to do (sth)。有时中间会插入副词，如 to unswervingly follow。
examples: The central government has published guidelines to regulate the pricing policies of elderly nursing homes.
Xi has emphasized the need to unswervingly follow the path of prioritizing ecological conservation and pursuing green development.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 -stal- 上，读作 no-STAL-jick。中间的 -stal- 中 /l/ 要清晰，/dʒ/ 类似汉语拼音的“之”但更浊更短，词尾 -ic 读 /ɪk/，不要读成 /aɪk/。整词节奏为“弱—强—弱”。
examples: The old department stores offer a nostalgic journey to the past.
Many visitors feel nostalgic when they see the retro storefronts.

reading.title: Old Stores, New Journeys: China's Cultural Travel Boom
reading.content:
In cities across China, old department stores are being given a new life. Rather than tearing down these buildings, developers are renovating them into cultural landmarks. They sell more than goods; they offer visitors a nostalgic journey to the past. Guests walk through retro halls, taste childhood snacks and take photos against old storefronts.

The trend shows how cultural travel is changing. Tourists today look for experiences and memories rather than souvenirs. At the same time, more people around the world are learning Chinese, hoping to understand the country's history, films and traditions. Language, like travel, opens a door to another culture.

Whether it is a century-old university commemorating its centenary or a new border bridge welcoming its first vehicles, China's story continues to attract curious visitors from home and abroad. Old memories, it seems, are becoming new destinations.
reading.translation:
在中国各地，老百货商场正迎来新生。开发商没有拆除这些老建筑，而是把它们翻新成文化地标。它们出售的不只是商品，更带给游客一场重返过去的怀旧之旅。人们走过复古的商场大厅，品尝儿时的零食，在旧式店面橱窗前拍照留念。

这一趋势显示出文化旅游的变迁。今天的游客寻找的是体验与回忆，而不只是纪念品。与此同时，全球越来越多的人开始学习中文，希望了解中国的历史、电影与传统。语言如同旅行，是通往另一种文化的大门。

无论是百年名校纪念其建校百年，还是边境新桥迎来首批车辆，中国的故事始终吸引着国内外好奇的游客。旧日的记忆，正成为新的旅行目的地。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 2026-10-17 ChinaDaily 报道《Old department stores sell nostalgic journey to past》《Why is the world learning Chinese?》《Xi congratulates Hunan University on its centenary》《New China-DPRK border bridge opens to traffic》改写整理，用于英语学习。
